calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_distinct, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, SUM(closing_value) AS val
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (
  SELECT store_key, product_key, closing_units, closing_value, etl_loaded_at,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY store_key, product_key) AS c,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_key, product_key ORDER BY etl_loaded_at) AS rn
  FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08'
),
d AS (SELECT a.store_key, a.product_key, a.closing_units u1, b.closing_units u2, a.closing_value v1, b.closing_value v2
      FROM w a JOIN w b ON a.store_key=b.store_key AND a.product_key=b.product_key AND a.rn=1 AND b.rn=2 WHERE a.c>1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_keys, SUM(CASE WHEN u1=u2 AND v1=v2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identical, SUM(v1) AS sum_first, SUM(v2) AS sum_second,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT store_key) FROM w WHERE c>1) AS stores_affected,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w WHERE c>2) AS triples
FROM d

WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-01'),
b AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08')
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, p.sku, p.category, p.subcategory, p.delisted_on, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING (store_key, product_key)
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = a.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = a.product_key
WHERE b.store_key IS NULL
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30

WITH dedup AS (
    -- one row per store version, article version and week (the 8 March load was repeated)
    SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, MAX(closing_value) AS closing_value, COUNT(*) AS copies
    FROM fact_stock_week
    WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT cp.category, d.week_ending_date, SUM(d.closing_value) AS weekly_value
    FROM dedup d
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = d.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = d.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, category,
       ROUND(AVG(weekly_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_stock_value, COUNT(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
